meta.themes: AI Regulation, Coding Agents, Safety Programs, Competitive Positioning

news.title: OpenAI sweetened its private-equity pitch amid an enterprise turf war with Anthropic
news.summary: Reuters reported OpenAI offered richer economics to attract private-equity partners as enterprise AI distribution became more competitive.

news.title: The White House pushed for its first major federal AI law this year
news.summary: Reuters said the administration was trying to land a broader federal AI bill in 2026, underscoring how quickly U.S. policy is moving from guidance toward legislation.

news.title: A U.S. advisory body warned that China's open-source lead could threaten U.S. AI dominance
news.summary: Reuters reported officials were increasingly concerned that China's open-source momentum could shape global standards and embodied-AI adoption.

news.title: EU antitrust officials intensified scrutiny by meeting major AI platform leaders
news.summary: Reuters reported Teresa Ribera met with leaders from Google, Meta, OpenAI, and Amazon as Europe tightened attention on AI market power.

news.title: OpenAI dropped the standalone Sora platform, jolting Disney and media partners
news.summary: Reuters reported OpenAI shut down the Sora app and ended a major Disney arrangement, showing how fast generative-media strategy can change when costs and risk shift.

news.title: A U.S. judge temporarily blocked the Pentagon's Anthropic blacklisting
news.summary: Reuters reported a judge paused the Defense Department action, giving Anthropic short-term relief in one of the most important government-AI vendor clashes to date.

news.title: South Korea committed $166 million to AI chip startup Rebellions
news.summary: Reuters reported new state-backed support for Rebellions, highlighting the growing geopolitical race to build domestic AI silicon capacity.

news.title: OpenAI published a deeper explanation of its Model Spec process
news.summary: OpenAI outlined how it updates the public Model Spec and identifies gaps, providing a more explicit governance framework for model behavior over time.

news.title: OpenAI launched a Safety Bug Bounty program focused on abuse and agentic risks
news.summary: OpenAI opened a new bug bounty effort targeting prompt injection, misuse, and other safety failures across its systems.

news.title: GitHub expanded Copilot for Jira with stronger MCP-driven context from Confluence
news.summary: GitHub added public-preview enhancements that let coding agent pull more planning context through Atlassian's MCP server.

news.title: GitHub added agent activity directly into Issues and Projects
news.summary: GitHub shipped planning-layer visibility for agent sessions, making it easier to track autonomous work from backlog through execution.

news.title: VS Code 1.113 bridged registered MCP servers into Copilot CLI and Claude agents
news.summary: Visual Studio Code connected its MCP server registry to external coding agents, tightening the loop between editor setup and agent execution.
